sourceProducts.description:
For the first time in 53 years, the New York Knicks are NBA Champions! Celebrate NY’s unforgettable playoff run with the Topps Now 2026 NBA Championship Team Set. Each set includes (15) Base Cards PLUS (1) Parallel, SP, Auto, or Auto-Relic per Championship Set.

Subject List:

Jalen Brunson

Josh Hart

OG Anunoby

Mikal Bridges

Karl-Anthony Towns

Landry Shamet

Miles McBride

Mitchell Robinson

Jose Alvarado

Jordan Clarkson

Pacôme Dadiet

Tyler Kolek

Ariel Hukporti

Mohamed Diawara

Jeremy Sochan

Image Variation Subjects:

Jalen Brunson

Karl-Anthony Towns

OG Anunoby

Mikal Bridges

Josh Hart

Landry Shamet

Mitchell Robinson

Jose Alvarado

Autograph Subjects:

Jalen Brunson

Karl-Anthony Towns

OG Anunoby

Mikal Bridges

Josh Hart

Landry Shamet

Miles McBride

Jose Alvarado

Jordan Clarkson

Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™

Topps NOW celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com. Print runs for every card are released in the NBA Topps NOW® Archive . 
Learn About the Topps NOW® Brand

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors. In an effort to mitigate our carbon footprint, shipments may be grouped together within the same order. Large orders may be consolidated into bulk packaging at Topps’ discretion.
